_readme: Shops near the Airbnb, researched Oct 2026 (Sonnet agent + spot checks). Coordinates estimated from addresses.

items.name: City SPAR Teréz körút 2
items.blurb: The nearest proper supermarket, right on the körút corner by the Airbnb. Beer, water, snacks and a hangover breakfast sorted.
items.tip: Sunday closing is early (16:00), so do not leave it late.

items.name: SPAR szupermarket Teréz körút 28
items.blurb: The bigger Spar up towards Oktogon. Best bet for a full lads' shop: crates, mixers, ice, breakfast stuff.
items.tip: Closes at 21:00, so be sorted well before the 22:00 alcohol cut-off.

items.name: Lidl Király utca 112
items.blurb: Cheapest big shop nearby and open until 22:00. Best spot for crates, snacks and a proper fry-up shop.
items.tip: Open later than the Spars, so it is the one for a last beer run before 22:00. Pin is from the address: check Maps.

items.name: SPAR market Erzsébet körút 27
items.blurb: Handy Spar a few minutes south down the körút towards Blaha Lujza tér.
items.tip: spar.hu has two listings for this building: Sunday close is 18:00 or 19:00, so go early.

items.name: Lidl Blaha Lujza tér
items.blurb: Backup big Lidl at Blaha Lujza tér, on the metro. Longer walk than the Király utca one.
items.tip: On the M2 at Blaha Lujza tér if the nearer Lidl is rammed.

items.name: Teréz Gyógyszertár
items.hours: Reported open 24 hours, with a night bell: phone first if it matters
items.blurb: Round-the-clock chemist for paracetamol, rehydration salts and plasters when the weekend bites back.
items.tip: At night you are served through a hatch. Ring the bell and have cash or a card ready.

items.name: dm drogéria
items.blurb: Toiletries, deodorant, toothpaste and hangover kit. Open on Sundays, which is the bit that matters.
items.tip: Close earlier on Sunday (18:00), so do not leave it late.

items.name: Rossmann
items.blurb: Rossmann on Király utca, practically next door. Rossmann says its Budapest shops open on Sundays.
items.tip: Address from an older Rossmann listing: check it is still there before you trek over.

goodToKnow.title: Buy the booze before 22:00
goodToKnow.body: District VII rules stop shops selling alcohol 22:00–06:00, and 2026 guides say the same for District VI: the shop stays open but the drink is locked away. Stock up before 10pm, and no wandering the street with an open can.

goodToKnow.title: Fags and vapes: tobacco shops only
goodToKnow.body: Cigarettes and vapes are only sold in a Nemzeti Dohánybolt (state tobacco shop), not in supermarkets. Look for the Nemzeti Dohánybolt sign with the 18 logo and blacked-out windows. Take photo ID. Google Maps shows the nearest.

goodToKnow.title: Bottle deposit: 50 HUF back
goodToKnow.body: Most cans and bottles carry a 50 HUF deposit (REpont logo). Feed them empty, unwashed, into the machines in bigger shops and take the voucher to the till. Small shops may take them by hand.

goodToKnow.title: Sundays are fine
goodToKnow.body: Supermarkets and dm open on Sundays, just shorter hours (the corner Spar shuts at 16:00). No public holidays fall on 15–18 Oct.
